title: Dependency resolved through the portal protocol
description: package.json declares a `portal:` dependency, a Yarn protocol that resolves a live directory. The consumer reads the directory at run time, so the package contents are not frozen by the install and can change between builds.
remediation: Publish the package and depend on a version that the lockfile pins.
limitation: It matches a `portal:` dependency, a Yarn protocol that resolves a live directory in the parsed package.json; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
